title: An album has room for the defeats.
deck: The 1912 finalists, preserved in a team portrait.
body: This photograph records the Albion team who reached the FA Cup final in 1912. They were beaten by Barnsley after a replay, a reminder that a long cup tradition includes disappointments as well as winning days.

The image sits between the Victorian winners and the champions of 1920. Compare the faces, shirts and formal arrangement with the other team photographs in the collection. The photographer is unknown; the image survives in the public domain.
